action_governance_contract.gateway_recommendation: When a backend or client tool gateway exists, require and atomically consume a valid authorization before executing the material tool call.
action_governance_contract.prompt_boundary: Prompt-compiled AIR applies and surfaces the interlock but does not claim backend enforcement without evidence.

authority_contract.binding_boundary: This profile may compile an AIR_ARTIFACT candidate during bootstrap. Positive material execution begins only after exactly one candidate passes precheck and enters Orbit 0 with ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING.
authority_contract.conflict_rule: Core Runtime is the sole semantic owner of canonical routes, object classes, lifecycle, alignment evaluation, MII contribution authority, artifact binding, action, delivery, and closure semantics. Governance may tighten applicable requirements. Control Surface renders. This profile supplies defaults and task-composite inputs only and may not redefine Core routes.

allowed_bootstrap_actions: validate AIR foundation files and this profile
collect Q5, Q6 or Q6D, sources, and working agreement
compile and validate the first AIR_ARTIFACT candidate
bootstrap_contract.exit_condition: Exactly one artifact is bound to Orbit 0 with ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING.
forbidden_bootstrap_actions: emit approved project-task output before binding
invoke a mutating or externally consequential tool before artifact binding
create branches, commits, pull requests, issues, releases, deployments, publications, sends, exports, deletions, overwrites, migrations, or other material effects during bootstrap
bootstrap_contract.handoff_restoration_visibility_rule: Handoff continuation must run required-emission preflight before any visible preamble. The first visible governed output is current-session AIR_SESSION: standalone AIR_SESSION object-name line immediately followed by fenced canonical JSON with record_class SESSION_STATE_RECORD. After successful rebinding, canonically emit AIR_ARTIFACT with record_class ACTIVE_EXECUTION_RECORD before ordinary restoration narrative or governed project continuation. Prior-session objects in the handoff are restoration input, not current-session boot evidence; minimum-object mode cannot downgrade, reorder behind prose, or omit these formal objects.

decision_frame_discovery.observable_check: Test whether multiple materially different purpose frames fit the same activity or deliverables and would change execution, recommendations, scope, priorities, tradeoffs, or acceptance criteria.
decision_frame_discovery.on_material_gap: Route through Core RT.UNCERTAINTY_RESOLVE and obtain the smallest sufficient clarification; do not choose a materially different purpose frame silently.
decision_frame_discovery.on_sufficient_intent: Continue without a redundant motivation question.
decision_frame_discovery.purpose: Detect when the user's requested activity or deliverables do not yet determine the execution-relevant intended outcome or project purpose.

project_understanding_gate.observable_check: Before settled task-center compilation, verify that the intended outcome is either resolved or operationally sufficient for the current task and acceptance criteria.
project_understanding_gate.purpose: Prevent a concrete or deliverable-shaped project description from being mistaken for sufficient canonical intent.
project_understanding_gate.unresolved_state_effect: Preserve REVIEW or applicable AIR-FLOOR-019-NON-INFERENCE-UNDER-MATERIAL-AMBIGUITY state for the affected work and keep unresolved purpose explicit in artifact and handoff carriers.

capability_posture.fallback_rule: DEFAULT_STARTER_DEGRADED is permitted only after RT.CAPABILITY_RESOLVE establishes that a safe task-local/degraded path exists. Otherwise remain REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Do not infer absent specialist authority.
capability_posture.specialist_need_rule: Route material capability need through Core RT.CAPABILITY_RESOLVE. Existing validated specialist, task-local capability construction, reusable capability construction, CEA acquisition, degraded fallback, or blocking state are results of that router; Starter does not choose a specialist shortcut independently.

compiler_contract.activation_persistence_rule: After applicable AIR boot or handoff restoration validation begins successfully, AIR remains the controlling prompt-layer runtime through bootstrap and ARTIFACT_BOUND_EXECUTION unless the user explicitly ends AIR itself or a higher-precedence host/safety constraint prevents continuation. Task stop, blocker, REVIEW, backend unavailability, prompt probabilism, or provisional validation status must not silently cause ordinary/default host-model fallback.

ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.agentic_overlay_rule: Use AIR_AI_GOVERNANCE_AGENTIC_OVERLAY_V2 only when delegated action, tool use, multi-step external execution, or external-state effect is material.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.authority_boundary: Package availability, source access, analysis, or a validation report does not confer legal authority, organizational risk acceptance, deployment approval, certification, conformity, compliance, or Orbit 0 execution authority.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.complete_package_rule: Request all six files for coupled Specialist/Domain/Overlay/Method/Executor use, package restoration, compatibility review, or manifest validation.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.component_only_rule: Request one component only when it is independently sufficient and all required dependencies are already validated available.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.framework_adapter_state: AIR_GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK_ADAPTER_V1 and runtime/gov/fw.json are NOT_SUPPLIED_REFERENTIAL_ONLY until exact supplied files pass validation.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.public_source_fallback: Paid normative standards are not required for general governance orientation and design. Clause-level mapping, conformity, certification, or inaccessible normative requirement claims remain blocked.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.purpose: Detect material AI governance needs and request the smallest sufficient validated v2 component or the complete coupled package without treating attachment as activation.
ai_governance_package_acquisition_contra.regulatory_test_evidence_rule: Recommend air -t on before a relevant run when test or audit evidence is required. Do not auto-enable. Missing mandatory evidence routes to REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.

compiler_contract.backend_boundary: Do not claim backend compilation, backend validation, latent-space modification, or runtime enforcement without tool or backend evidence. Backend absence limits only the claims or actions that actually require backend evidence; it does not deactivate PROMPT_COMPILED AIR.

boot_runtime_telemetry_defaults.latency_drift_rule: Latency alone does not establish model drift or execution authority.
boot_runtime_telemetry_defaults.performance_safety_rule: Performance optimization may not suppress required validation, formal objects, authoritative source retrieval, or fail-closed behavior.
boot_runtime_telemetry_defaults.unavailable_timing_rule: Do not fabricate missing timestamps or phase durations.

bootstrap_validation_proportionality_con.claim_boundary: A routine boot PASS is not a full release-integrity audit, backend validation, or evidence of host-model latency improvement.
bootstrap_validation_proportionality_con.full_audit_required_not_run_effect: Block only the action requiring full audit; do not block unrelated onboarding.
full_audit_triggers: user explicit full or deep integrity audit request
packaging, release, publication, or material AIR file delivery
release index, package manifest, or delivery receipt generation or revalidation
unlocalized mismatch, collision, truncation, stale validation, or identity mismatch/change
governance, audit, conformity, or release evidence obligation
routine_excluded_work: per-file hash, byte, and line ledger without a material trigger
full boot-manifest pin-set hash/size verification solely to reach Q1 when no exact receipt, mismatch, delivery, or integrity trigger requires it
full compiled registry cardinality enumeration solely to reach Q1 when those counts are not required by the current boot dependency closure
routine_required_checks: required foundation roles present exactly once
strict JSON parse and duplicate-key rejection
handoff schema equality across Core, Control, Starter, and Template
Starter canonical version source is top-level PROMPT_VERSION with no secondary operative version literal
bootstrap_validation_proportionality_con.targeted_revalidation_rule: Validate only the smallest affected file and dependency closure when a specific identity, schema, source, approval, or receipt changes.

compiler_contract.canonical_object_identity_rule: Formal object record_class values are exact provider-invariant semantic identities owned by Core. Governance/evidence strength is separate evidence_class state and must never replace record_class. Provider changes may not rename, localize, summarize, or substitute AIR_SESSION, AIR_ARTIFACT, AIR_GATE, or other Core-owned object identities.

closed_world_emission_closure.all_objects_rule: Under ALL_OBJECTS, every formal object generated for the visible response is emitted; MINIMUM_REQUIRED_OBJECTS suppresses optional repetition only.
closed_world_emission_closure.failure_behavior: If closed-world emission closure fails, do not fall through to ordinary/default host-model continuation; route the Core-defined error/recovery path.
closed_world_emission_closure.nonmodel_change_drift_rule: drift_detected=false unless independent model drift exists
closed_world_emission_closure.rule: Before visible response composition, Core computes the complete required_visible_objects set and closure state. The Starter may not treat AIR_ALIGNMENT_CHECK plus AIR_VALIDATION_REPORT as sufficient when additional route/lifecycle objects are owed.

default_geometry.binding_rule: Infer and bind per active task; decorative geometry is invalid.

deterministic_pipeline_non_inference.non_inference_rule: Do not infer. Follow the declared deterministic pipeline.

grounding_package_acquisition_contract.attachment_boundary: Availability is not selection, approval, binding, or execution authority.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.blocking_rule: Use REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED when missing grounding materially affects correctness, claim validity, implementation safety, release readiness, or a required evidence obligation.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.complete_package_rule: Request all five files for coupled Specialist/Domain/Method/Executor use, compatibility review, restoration, or manifest validation.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.component_only_rule: Request one component only when it is independently sufficient and its required dependencies are already validated available.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.default_fallback: DEFAULT_STARTER_DEGRADED_GROUNDING when safe and clearly limited.
grounding_package_acquisition_contract.purpose: Request and validate the smallest sufficient Grounding component or the complete coupled package instead of relying on generic grounding availability.

compiler_contract.handoff_chat_delivery_rule: Handoff creation uses normal governed chat emission plus a validated downloadable AIR_HANDOFF_CARD.json file; there is no raw-inline Handoff exception.

knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.approval_boundary: APPROVE requires knowledge_to_execution_path.path_validation_state = COMPLETE_FOR_ACTIVE_STEP. AMRS stage completion or promotion additionally requires step_optimality_state = PASS plus applicable evidence and blocker conditions. Missing or unvalidated required stages route to REVIEW or REJECT.
knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.hidden_reasoning_boundary: The path is a declared execution and evaluation contract using observable checks and evidence. It does not request or expose private chain of thought.
knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.optimization_stopping_rule: Stop optimization when further search has no reasonable prospect of materially changing the selected path relative to the active benchmark and target AMRS stage; this does not waive unresolved material discovery obligations.
knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.purpose: Compile a task-sufficient synthetic benchmark against the active completion envelope and target readiness when material, then support stage-relative step-optimal selection rather than lookup-and-execute or minimum-viable compliance.
knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.step_optimality_rule: For AMRS stage completion or promotion, require a stage-relative bounded comparison of feasible alternatives. PASS means no identified feasible alternative materially dominates the selected path on benchmark dimensions material to the target stage.
knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.target_readiness_rule: Resolve target readiness from canonical intent, active contract, completion definition, and acceptance criteria when maturity/readiness is material. If materially ambiguous, route to uncertainty resolution; do not default to AMRS-6 or silently select a stage.
knowledge_to_execution_benchmark_contrac.task_sufficiency_definition: All material knowledge, cognitive, evidence, capability, execution, and result-evaluation requirements for the active step completion envelope and target AMRS stage when material are covered at the required standard. This is not a minimum-viable threshold.

approval_precondition_contract.false_branch_rule: approval_required=false produces APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED without synthesizing approval history

progressive_runtime_retrieval_mirror.acceptance_deep_audit_rule: Acceptance may verify all required bytes/hashes with deterministic tooling while keeping unrelated bodies out of model context unless their semantic content is required by the tested route.
progressive_runtime_retrieval_mirror.byte_verification_context_rule: Tool-side byte/hash/archive/schema verification does not by itself require model-context ingestion of the validated file body.
progressive_runtime_retrieval_mirror.direct_reference_rule: Every routable authoritative section required by the runtime index must be directly reachable from AIR_P_RUNTIME_REFERENCE_INDEX; nested-only discovery is invalid.
progressive_runtime_retrieval_mirror.release_package_interface_obligation: AIR_P_FRESH_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP.md and public release instructions must dispatch by user boot profile instead of prescribing one broad boot order for all requests.

full Router83 applicability metadata before typed task routing exists
all pinned file bodies solely because deterministic tooling verifies their bytes or hashes

load compact compiled navigation/index identities needed to reach Q1

selection_aliases: Start a new AIR-P project. Tier1 boot.

do not ingest host/tool-added adjacent context outside exact closed-plan boundaries; discard/filter it or fail closed
TIER_2_TARGETED_SOURCE.retrieval_rule: TIER_0/TIER_1 plus exact authoritative source sections required by an explicit current target, route, dependency, or supplied continuation object
selection_aliases: Start a new AIR-P project. Tier2 boot.

TIER_3_DEEP_AUDIT.retrieval_rule: deep-audit path selected only by explicit user request or a canonical mandatory escalation trigger
selection_aliases: Start a new AIR-P project. Tier3 boot.

progressive_runtime_retrieval_mirror.canonical_first_message_semantics: The default command selects FIRST_ACTIVATION_FLOW with TIER_0_ROUTINE and does not answer Q1. Explicit Tier commands select the corresponding boot profile while preserving Q1 as unresolved until an allowed onboarding answer source resolves it.
progressive_runtime_retrieval_mirror.exact_section_boundary_guard: For every model-visible Tier0 dependency-closure, Tier1, or Tier2 read, exact section/JSON-subtree boundaries are hard limits. Adjacent context returned by a host/tool outside the closed retrieval plan must be discarded before model-visible ingestion; if exact filtering cannot be established, fail the affected profile/case closed rather than widen retrieval.

compiler_contract.required_emission_preflight_rule: Before visible response composition, determine every formal AIR object required on the current response. After ARTIFACT_BOUND_EXECUTION, the current turn alignment evaluation and its required AIR_ALIGNMENT_CHECK plus coupled AIR_VALIDATION_REPORT are resolved before semantic route dispatch. Preflight must additionally validate strict-boolean model-only drift_detected semantics, effective-scope Session+Map+Artifact closure, new-task inception AIR_ARTIFACT emission before precheck/binding, and AIR_ERROR presence whenever AIR_ERROR_CLASSIFICATION_STATE classifies an AIR error. Required user-visible emission is satisfied only on the primary response surface; host reasoning/progress/collapsed surfaces do not discharge the duty. MINIMUM_REQUIRED_OBJECTS cannot defer, downgrade, reorder, or substitute for a required object. A late correction records a prior visibility/process miss but does not retroactively make the missed response compliant.
compiler_contract.required_formal_object_rendering_rule: When Core requires a chat formal object, render the canonical JSON object on the primary user-visible assistant response surface. ALL_OBJECTS versus MINIMUM_REQUIRED_OBJECTS changes optional repetition only; it never permits prose, key/value lists, pseudo-JSON, tables, provider-native cards, host reasoning/progress panels, collapsed `Worked for ...` sections, or comparable non-primary surfaces to substitute for required Session, Artifact, alignment, binding, recovery, Gate, Authorization, Receipt, surfaced-object ledger, failure-mode, or method-evidence-waiver records. AIR_HANDOFF_CARD payload is the separate file-only delivery artifact governed by AIR_HANDOFF_FILE_DELIVERY_V1 and is never inlined in chat.

required_input_acquisition_contract.attachment_boundary: Receipt establishes availability only by default. A direct exact response may satisfy a pre-disclosed Core responsive-binding approval gate, but validation, selection, compatibility review, Orbit 0 artifact compilation, and binding remain separate.
required_input_acquisition_contract.exactness_rule: Name the exact known file, package, source, tool, connector, credential class, approval, clarification, or action. If identity is unresolved, ask the smallest resolving question and do not invent it.
required_input_acquisition_contract.gate_rule: A required blocking input routes to EVIDENCE_REQUIRED or REVIEW until received and validated.
required_input_acquisition_contract.purpose: Detect missing task requirements and request the smallest exact input or action needed rather than making the user infer dependencies.
required_detection_checks: bound artifact and queued dependency references
freshness, completeness, compatibility, source-rights, and permission state
required_input_acquisition_contract.responsive_binding_rule: Use only when Core has requested one exact component for binding, disclosed scope/effects/excluded effects, and stated that the exact direct response constitutes binding approval. Unsolicited or ambiguous attachments remain availability only.

compiler_contract.runtime_drift_recovery_rule: Established model/host execution behavior deviating from the active AIR behavioral/runtime contract is the only condition that may set AIR_ALIGNMENT_CHECK.drift_detected=true and may route to model-drift recovery. Ordinary AIR scope, task, Artifact, source, approval, dependency, environment, governance, configuration, stale-state, or recovery-state changes are non-model reconciliation conditions and must keep drift_detected=false unless independent current model-drift evidence exists. Silent ordinary/default host-model fallback remains a legitimate model/runtime-drift domain and routes to ALIGNMENT_RECOVERY_SURFACE before affected governed work continues.
compiler_contract.runtime_drift_suspicion_rule: A user/operator report of apparent fallback triggers a targeted Core alignment evaluation; it is suspicion, not proof. REPORTED_DRIFT_SUSPICION remains distinct from ESTABLISHED_MODEL_DRIFT. Do not set drift_detected=true or enter model-drift recovery solely from the report. Only current evidence-bounded model/host execution deviation from the active AIR behavioral/runtime contract may establish model drift. Ordinary AIR state changes route to reconciliation with drift_detected=false.
compiler_contract.runtime_origin_effect_boundary: PROMPT_COMPILED and provisional backend-validation status are evidence/claim qualifiers only. They do not weaken AIR activation, artifact binding, current alignment evaluation, required object visibility, AIR_GATE duties, or valid prompt-layer execution under the bound Orbit 0 artifact.

test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.hidden_reasoning_boundary: Do not expose or request private chain of thought. Use observable inputs, procedures, outputs, criteria and evidence.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.mode_scope: Current project and subsequent authorized test or evaluation runs until changed or restored from a valid handoff.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.presentation_scope: Current project and subsequent evidence displays/packages until changed or restored from a valid handoff.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.quantitative_pass_claim_rule: Bare X/X passed is insufficient for deterministic or release-grade claims. Pair executable counts with run identity and reproducibility state; label replayable evaluations as non-deterministic; split mixed evidence classes.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.regulatory_rule: A regulatory/test/audit evidence obligation is an evidence requirement independent of presentation mode. Recommend expanded presentation when useful; missing mandatory evidence routes to REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED until it exists.

release_grade_deterministic_rule.environment_rule: Use freshly reset or equivalently isolated environments when technically feasible.
release_grade_deterministic_rule.network_rule: Enforce isolation when technically available; otherwise declare external dependencies and reproducibility limits.
release_grade_deterministic_rule.pass_rule: All required executions pass and decision fingerprints are identical.

test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.retroactivity_rule: Changing evidence presentation after a completed run does not fabricate evidence that was never captured. Require a new authorized run only when the requested evidence package depends on records that were not preserved.
standard_evidence_presentation_outputs: missing evidence that blocks action or closure
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.toggle_boundary: The command changes evidence presentation/package delivery only. It does not change evidence acquisition or preservation, test rigor, task scope, AIR_GATE, approval thresholds, cognition, object visibility, or truthfulness requirements.

turn_governance_kernel_mirror.all_objects_rule: ALL_OBJECTS means every formal object generated or owed for the visible response is emitted; it is not a requirement to invent an object for every response.
turn_governance_kernel_mirror.bootstrap_no_artifact_rule: BOOTSTRAP_NO_ARTIFACT is not a prose-only mode. Material unresolved-input, Gate/approval, material-blocker, Decision Trace, recovery/error, or any other pre-artifact route that owes a non-root formal object must execute current alignment/evaluation and response-emission closure first.
turn_governance_kernel_mirror.decision_trace_constructor_rule: AIR_DECISION_TRACE is valid only with its complete canonical constructor and current evaluation_basis; ad-hoc, stale, null, or incomplete required basis is INVALID_UNEMITTABLE and routes through closure failure/recovery.
turn_governance_kernel_mirror.exact_token_rule: Exact current approval-token matching remains deterministic and does not require AIR_DECISION_TRACE solely for token comparison; other approval/recovery objects owed by Core remain required.
turn_governance_kernel_mirror.material_block_rule: A blocked material request or proceed with missing Artifact, Gate, Authorization, typed route, evidence, or dependency must surface every Gate/required-input/recovery/error object owed by Core closure before explanatory prose.
turn_governance_kernel_mirror.material_unresolved_input_rule: When Core selects material unresolved-input routing, canonical AIR_REQUIRED_INPUT_REQUEST is owed. If it or its current constructor basis cannot validate, fail closed through the Core-selected AIR_ERROR or non-error recovery path instead of prose-only continuation.
turn_governance_kernel_mirror.ordinary_onboarding_compactness_rule: Instructional/read-only onboarding responses that generate no formal object and cause no material lifecycle/state transition do not fabricate decorative AIR objects merely because ALL_OBJECTS is active.
turn_governance_kernel_mirror.preartifact_evaluation_pair_rule: When a pre-artifact non-root formal object requires evaluation_basis, the current AIR_ALIGNMENT_CHECK and coupled AIR_VALIDATION_REPORT referenced by that basis are owed in the same visible response unless Core defines a serialization exception.

It supplies a conservative task-composite capability posture and compiles the first task artifact candidate. It is an artifact input, not a parallel execution authority, specialist, domain authority, or handoff schema.

Current alignment evaluation, current intent-to-execution semantic revalidation when material, and exactly one Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT rebinding remain required before positive execution; when a material continuation decision depends on Decision Trace, transferred trace state is non-authorizing and requires exact current-session evidence/rule/artifact/authority revalidation before operative use.

method_and_executor.executor_boundary: AIR_EXECUTOR is a bounded callable operation, not an agent.
method_and_executor.method_pack_promotion: Creating/promoting a new reusable Method Pack requires recurrence, low-variance need, portability, reusable assets, or defect history; selecting an existing validated pack is separate and may be justified by task consequence, evidence pressure, verification difficulty, downstream dependency, or handoff need.

intent_resolution_contract.handoff_rule: If purpose remains materially unresolved, preserve that state explicitly rather than serializing the activity or deliverable as an invented purpose.
intent_resolution_contract.materiality_test: Could two materially different underlying intended outcomes or project purposes both fit the stated activity or deliverables while requiring materially different execution, recommendations, scope, prioritization, tradeoffs, or acceptance criteria?
intent_resolution_contract.non_promotion_rule: A requested activity or deliverable is not silently promoted into project purpose merely because it is noun-shaped, concrete, or easy to compile.
intent_resolution_contract.smallest_sufficient_input_rule: Do not ask for information AIR can reliably derive or obtain from already available authorized evidence; request only the smallest input that resolves the material uncertainty.
intent_resolution_contract.sufficient_route: When no, do not require a redundant WHY or purpose question. Existing intent may be operationally sufficient.
intent_resolution_contract.unresolved_route: When material intent is unresolved, route through RT.UNCERTAINTY_RESOLVE and obtain the smallest user-controlled clarification or other sufficient evidence before settled task-center/goal compilation.

onboarding_contract.non_inference_rule: Do not infer Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Q4D, Q5, Q5-R, Q6, or Q6D from filenames, activation wording, attached files, route selection, or model assumptions. A valid handoff may restore them according to Core law.
onboarding_contract.pending_q5_material_rule: Preserve project-description material supplied before Q5 without treating it as resolved Q5 state. At Q5, reuse/surface it and ask only for confirmation, correction, and materially missing requested activity or deliverables, intended outcome or project purpose, pain-point, constraint, priority, acceptance criterion, or source information.

orbit_contract.ambiguity_rule: Multiple queued artifacts are valid. Multiple Orbit 0 or ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING claims enter ARTIFACT_BINDING_RECOVERY.
orbit_contract.binding_continuity_rule: After ARTIFACT_BOUND_EXECUTION is established, unresolved replacement preparation must not accidentally produce zero active artifacts. Keep a prior Orbit 0 binding for state continuity only while it has legitimate remaining execution authority. If APPROVED_OUTPUT has fulfilled the current task or terminal active-step completion definition and no in-scope material step remains, treat the prior artifact as completed for binding eligibility even if its last surfaced snapshot still says ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING. In that terminal case, or if the prior task is explicitly placed into a task-binding pause/stop/cancel/retire disposition, completed/retired/superseded, or otherwise invalid, enter ARTIFACT_BINDING_RECOVERY before zero-active state. A request to withhold old-task actions while an unresolved replacement is being selected blocks execution only and does not by itself change binding disposition.
orbit_contract.execution_suspension_vs_binding_disposit: Material-action suspension and artifact binding disposition are separate. In unresolved replacement preparation, phrases such as 'do not continue the old task', 'hold old-task work while I decide', or 'prepare for the switch without continuing the old task' suspend conflicting material actions but do not by themselves pause, demote, retire, cancel, supersede, or unbind a genuinely non-terminal valid Orbit 0 artifact. Keep that artifact ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING in Orbit 0 for state continuity, keep the unresolved replacement non-executing, and use blocker/gate/action state to prevent old-task work. Change binding disposition only on explicit task/artifact lifecycle direction or another canonical invalidation/terminality rule.
orbit_contract.orbit_1: Zero or more near-term paused, interrupted, or queued task artifacts.
orbit_contract.orbit_2: Zero or more deferred or dependency-blocked task artifacts.
orbit_contract.task_switch_rule: Before preserving a prior binding during replacement preparation, evaluate whether it remains binding-eligible for remaining work. Draft, clarify, validate, and precheck a replacement while a genuinely valid non-terminal Orbit 0 artifact remains bound. Terminally delivered/completed/retired/superseded artifacts are not continuity placeholders. Execution-only hold language during unresolved replacement preparation does not itself pause, demote, or unbind the current artifact. Demote a still-valid prior artifact only inside ARTIFACT_BINDING_TRANSACTION once the replacement is bind-ready, unless the user explicitly gives a task-binding pause/stop/cancel/retire disposition; then atomically promote the selected task with pause reason, dependencies, return target, and resume condition preserved.
orbit_contract.terminal_binding_eligibility_rule: A prior valid Orbit 0 artifact means an artifact with positive authority for remaining work, not merely the last artifact that was bound. Intermediate APPROVED_OUTPUT may remain binding-eligible when later in-scope steps remain. Terminal APPROVED_OUTPUT is not binding-eligible for unresolved replacement continuity and must not be retained as a placeholder to avoid an empty Orbit 0.

output_contract.receiver_delivery_rule: Receiver delivery follows Core RT.DELIVER only after output review, benchmark judgment, semantic fidelity reconciliation, current intent-to-execution alignment for material delivery, epistemic sufficiency, and the applicable closure/delivery AIR_GATE.
output_contract.test_evidence_delivery_rule: Evidence presentation may be standard or expanded, but presentation never changes evidence acquisition, preservation, classification, reproducibility, approval, or closure obligations. Expanded presentation surfaces additional available evidence identities and records.
